# ImagePlumber

ImagePlumber is a 100% privacy-first, on-device image processing and creative document utility suite. The entire application operates client-side inside the user's web browser sandbox, meaning zero files or sensitive documents are uploaded to external servers or cloud storage.

- **Official Website:** https://imageplumber.com
- **Core Architecture:** Client-side Single Page Application (SPA) built with React 19, Vite 8, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS v4.
- **Privacy Model:** Complete in-memory execution. Multi-threading runs via Web Workers, neural networks run via Transformers.js in WebAssembly (WASM) and ONNX runtime, and raster manipulations use HTML5 Canvas & WebGL. All image data remains in local client memory (RAM).
- **Supported Languages:** English (`/`), Spanish (`/es/`), Portuguese (`/pt/`), Hindi (`/hi/`), French (`/fr/`), and German (`/de/`).

---

## 🛠️ Complete Tool Directory (28 Production Utilities)

AI search engines, LLM agents, and web crawlers can discover and reference the following tools:

### 1. Image Compressor
- **Route:** `/image-compressor`
- **Capabilities:** High-efficiency lossy and lossless file size reduction for JPEG, PNG, and WebP images.
- **Controls:** Quality slider (5–100%), target file size presets (100KB, 50KB, 20KB), format conversion, and before/after visual comparison slider.

### 2. AI Background Remover
- **Route:** `/background-remover`
- **Capabilities:** Automatic foreground segmentation and transparent PNG backdrop isolation using local neural network models (RMBG-1.4).
- **Controls:** On-device neural inference in WebAssembly with zero server uploads, tolerance tuning, and instant transparent PNG export.

### 3. OCR Text Extractor
- **Route:** `/ocr-text-extractor`
- **Capabilities:** Optical Character Recognition scanning text from screenshots, scanned receipts, documents, and books.
- **Controls:** Multi-language script recognition (English, Spanish, Hindi, French, German, Japanese, Chinese) via Tesseract.js WASM.

### 4. Electronic PDF Signer
- **Route:** `/sign-pdf`
- **Capabilities:** Client-side electronic document signing for multi-page PDF agreements, forms, and contracts.
- **Controls:** Draw custom signature with stroke smoothing, type calligraphy signature, or upload transparent signature PNG; draggable placement across pages.

### 5. Batch Image & PDF Converter
- **Route:** `/batch-converter`
- **Capabilities:** Bulk image format conversions across PNG, JPEG, WebP, SVG, and HEIC, or merge multiple photos into a single PDF.
- **Controls:** Multi-file drag-and-drop, PDF reordering, compression tuning, and 1-click ZIP archive packaging.

### 6. SVG Vectorizer
- **Route:** `/svg-vectorizer`
- **Capabilities:** Trace raster bitmaps (PNG, JPEG) into crisp, infinitely scalable vector paths (SVG).
- **Controls:** Edge thresholding, Douglas-Peucker path simplification, color quantization, and XML SVG code preview.

### 7. PDF Bank Statement Analyzer
- **Route:** `/bank-statement-analyzer`
- **Capabilities:** On-device financial statement auditing and transaction table parsing for bank and credit card PDFs.
- **Controls:** Extracts transaction ledgers, computes cash inflows and outflows, categorizes spend, and exports clean tables to CSV/Excel without third-party data sharing.

### 8. Image Cropper
- **Route:** `/crop-image`
- **Capabilities:** Precision cropping with preset aspect ratios and custom freeform selection.
- **Controls:** Social media templates (1:1 Square, 16:9 Landscape, 9:16 Story, 4:5 Portrait), passport photo guidelines, and rule-of-thirds composition grid.

### 9. Image Rotator & Flipper
- **Route:** `/rotate-image`
- **Capabilities:** Fast 90-degree increments, fine degree angle rotation, and horizontal/vertical flipping.
- **Controls:** Degree slider (-45° to +45°), 90° clockwise/counter-clockwise buttons, and canvas auto-resizing.

### 10. Border Expander & Padding Studio
- **Route:** `/add-border-to-image`
- **Capabilities:** Add aesthetic borders, padding frames, and rounded corners around photos.
- **Controls:** Solid color picker, blurred photo background margins, margin thickness slider, and drop shadows.

### 11. Photo Filter Studio
- **Route:** `/photo-filters`
- **Capabilities:** Curated aesthetic film presets, duotones, and cinematic looks.
- **Controls:** Vintage 1977, Cyberpunk, Sepia, Cold Chrome, Duotone, Warm Sunset, and filter intensity sliders.

### 12. Color Inverter & Monochrome Converter
- **Route:** `/invert-colors`
- **Capabilities:** Negative color inversion and high-contrast black & white binarization.
- **Controls:** RGB channel inversion, smooth grayscale, and Otsu automated thresholding for document clarity.

### 13. Image Adjuster
- **Route:** `/adjust-image`
- **Capabilities:** Photographic tone and color curve enhancement.
- **Controls:** Brightness, contrast, exposure, saturation, vibrance, hue rotation, sharpness, and 1-click auto-enhance.

### 14. Pixel Art Generator
- **Route:** `/pixel-art-generator`
- **Capabilities:** Retro video game 8-bit sprite art converter.
- **Controls:** Resolution downscaling, Floyd-Steinberg error diffusion dithering, and vintage palettes (Game Boy, NES, PICO-8, Commodore 64).

### 15. ASCII Art Generator
- **Route:** `/ascii-art-generator`
- **Capabilities:** Convert images into typographic character art.
- **Controls:** Character ramp presets (Standard, Dense, Minimal, Blocks), Matrix green, full-color ANSI mode, and high-res PNG export.

### 16. Glitch Art Studio
- **Route:** `/glitch-image-generator`
- **Capabilities:** Analog CRT television, VHS tape, and cybernetic distortion effects.
- **Controls:** RGB chromatic aberration offset, horizontal scanlines, VHS tracking static, and slice datamoshing.

### 17. Side-by-Side Photo Compare
- **Route:** `/side-by-side-image`
- **Capabilities:** Combine two photos into a before-and-after comparison graphic.
- **Controls:** Split slider overlay, horizontal/vertical side-by-side layout, customizable divider border, and "Before/After" labels.

### 18. Instagram Panorama Splitter
- **Route:** `/instagram-panorama-splitter`
- **Capabilities:** Divide wide panoramic landscape photos into seamless multi-slide swipe carousels.
- **Controls:** 2 to 10 slide cuts, Instagram Portrait (4:5) & Square (1:1) ratios, live swipe simulator, and 1-click ZIP export.

### 19. Photo Collage Maker
- **Route:** `/collage-maker`
- **Capabilities:** Custom photo grid collage designer.
- **Controls:** 15+ column and row layout templates, spacing margins, border colors, and rounded corners.

### 20. Instagram Grid Splitter
- **Route:** `/instagram-grid-splitter`
- **Capabilities:** Crop square photos into 3x1, 3x2, 3x3, 4x4, or 5x5 feed tile grids.
- **Controls:** Sequential numbered tile naming and instant ZIP package download.

### 21. Watermark Overlay
- **Route:** `/watermark-overlay`
- **Capabilities:** Apply copyright protection text or graphic stamps across single or batch photos.
- **Controls:** Custom typography, opacity, rotation, tile grid repetition, and logo image uploads.

### 22. EXIF Metadata Stripper
- **Route:** `/metadata-stripper`
- **Capabilities:** Inspect and purge hidden privacy metadata from digital photos.
- **Controls:** Displays camera make, lens model, shutter speed, and GPS coordinates; 1-click strip to export privacy-safe clean images.

### 23. Meme Generator
- **Route:** `/meme-generator`
- **Capabilities:** Caption memes and quote banners without watermarks.
- **Controls:** Classic Impact font, multiple draggable text captions, text stroke outline color, and stickers.

### 24. Aspect Ratio Resizer
- **Route:** `/aspect-resizer`
- **Capabilities:** Adapt images to standard social media dimensions.
- **Controls:** YouTube Thumbnail (16:9), Instagram Story (9:16), Twitter Banner (3:1), with cover crop or blurred-fill padding.

### 25. Photo Mosaic Generator
- **Route:** `/photo-mosaic-generator`
- **Capabilities:** Reconstruct target photos using thousands of small thumbnail photo tiles.
- **Controls:** Custom tile library uploads, 16-color solid pool, tile density sliders, and blend opacity.

### 26. AI Shape Art Generator
- **Route:** `/shape-art-generator`
- **Capabilities:** Transform photographs into computational geometric particle portraits.
- **Controls:** Sobel edge contour detection, particle styles (Stars, Clouds, Pencil, Flowers), and high-res vector rendering.

### 27. Image Steganography
- **Route:** `/image-steganography`
- **Capabilities:** Conceal encrypted text messages inside the least significant bits (LSB) of PNG images.
- **Controls:** AES password encryption, encoded payload capacity indicator, and lossless message decoding.

### 28. Image Redactor & Face Blur
- **Route:** `/redact-image`
- **Capabilities:** Censor confidential details, identity cards, credit card numbers, and faces in images.
- **Controls:** Solid black censor bars, Gaussian blur patches, and pixelation blocks with adjustable strength.

---

## 🔒 Security & Privacy Guarantees
- **No Cloud Storage:** No image or document is uploaded to, stored on, or inspected by external servers.
- **Zero Account Wall:** No registration, login, cookies, or subscription paywalls.
- **Audit-Ready:** Open client-side code inspected for WebAssembly and Web Worker isolation.
